items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: And Shorty Baker, Harold Baker. I worked with him in Don Redman's band.

ctx.x: And Shorty Baker, Harold Baker. I worked with him in Don Redman's band. In fact, we took him away from St. Louis in 1936. Don picked him up. He was a slow reader and Don taught him how to read. Like I told you, it was the same as going to school when you worked with Don.
